picks.title: Finding Comfort in Suffering | Studies with Stearman
picks.summary:
Why does God allow suffering? Why do faithful Christians endure trials, persecution, and heartbreak?

Today Gary begins an in-depth study of 2 Corinthians, one of Paul's most personal letters. Paul opens the epistle by repeatedly emphasizing one central theme: God is the God of all comfort.
picks.reason: A serious Christian reflection on suffering and divine comfort through Paul's letter.
